events.text: A concrete general defect has emerged: conventional-axis discovery recognizes rotation axes by searching a hard-coded catalog of short integer vectors. Under a legitimate unimodular basis change, an ordinary symmetry axis can become a primitive integer vector absent from that catalog. The code then continues with an invalid axis index and searches the wrong centering/type; this explains Hall 9. I’m replacing that lookup with an exact integer nullspace calculation and checking all callers for proper failure handling.
